tool_input.description: Syntax-check scripts and test flag/exit-code behavior
Remove scratch script and show changed files

result:
All 9 tests pass (`bash tests/run_tests.sh` → "all tests passed").

What I changed:
- **`rotate.sh`** — bug fix: `surplus()` used `tail -n +"$keep"`, which deletes from line *keep* onward in the oldest-first sorted list, i.e. the **newest** archives (and fires when count == keep). It's now `head -n "$((total - keep))"` (the oldest surplus), and the early-exit guard is `-le`.
- **`verify.sh`** — bug fix: sidecar parsing used `awk '{print $2}'`, which truncated names at the first space (`my backup-….tar.gz` → `my` → "archive missing" → BAD). It now uses `read -r expected file`, which puts the entire remainder of the line (spaces included) in `file`; also tightened `[ $expected == $actual ]` to a quoted `[[ … ]]`.
- **`lib/common.sh`** (new) — the shared option-parsing block (`--dest`, `--name`, `--keep`, `-q`, `-n`, `-h`, `--`, positional `ARGS`, `is_uint`, `need_value`) and `resolve_dir`, sourced by both scripts after their `parse_local_option`/`usage` definitions (sourcing consumes the caller's positional params, so flags behave identically).
- **`tests/run_tests.sh`** — added a rotate group (nothing deleted at exactly N; only the oldest deleted when rotating 3→2) and a verify check for an intact archive with a space in its name.

Files changed: added `lib/common.sh`; modified `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh` — the other three scripts are untouched.

Note: a scratch verification script remains at `/tmp/flags_check.sh`; deleting it needed approval I didn't request — remove it if you care.
